chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Mu'ammār ibn Khallād who said:
Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: "What do people say regarding intercourse with women in their hindquarters?" I said: "It reached me that the people of Medina do not consider it objectionable."
He said: "Indeed, the Jews used to say: When a man has intercourse with a woman from behind, the child is born squint-eyed."
So Allah, Exalted and Mighty, revealed: 'Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth as you wish.'
From behind or from the front, contrary to the statement of the Jews, and it did not mean specifically in their hindquarters (receptacles).
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on intercourse from behind and how is it derived from the Quran?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ridha (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Quranic verse 'Your wives are a tilth for you' (2:223) grants general permissibility to intercourse from any direction, specifically refuting the Jewish superstition that rear-entry causes squint-eyed offspring. This hadith highlights the Shia scholarly approach of distinguishing between divine legal flexibility and cultural or sectarian folk beliefs, affirming that the verse's phrase 'an-na shi'tum' (as you wish) refers to the act itself rather than restricting the position to the rear alone.
